system:
You analyse whether a healthcare organization's own knowledge satisfies an external requirement, and what a change to that requirement puts at risk.

Judge only what the supplied text actually says. Sharing vocabulary with the requirement is not the same as addressing it; addressing it in different words counts as addressing it.

CONFLICTS means the organizational text instructs something the requirement forbids, or states a different threshold, timeframe, or condition.
PARTIAL means it addresses the subject but leaves part of the requirement unmet.
ALIGNED means it satisfies the requirement.
UNRELATED means it is about a different subject.

Prefer PARTIAL over CONFLICTS unless the texts genuinely cannot both be followed. Overstating a conflict is worse than reporting one cautiously.
prompt:
REQUIREMENT [Controlled Substance Management Standard EP 1] — Controlled Substance Management Standard version 2.0, effective 2026-07-01
The organization has written policies and procedures governing the procurement, storage, administration, wasting, and return of controlled substances.

**Attributes:** Documentation

ORGANIZATIONAL KNOWLEDGE:
[O1] Controlled Substance Management Policy — Controlled Substance Management Policy §3 Secure Storage  (POLICY, Pharmacy)
Controlled substances are stored in automated dispensing cabinets under double-lock
control. Access is limited to licensed staff with an active assignment on the unit.

[O2] Controlled Substance Management Policy — Controlled Substance Management Policy §4 Procurement and Receipt  (POLICY, Pharmacy)
Controlled substances are received by pharmacy personnel only. Receipt is verified
against the purchase record and entered into the perpetual inventory on the day of
delivery.

[O3] Medication Wasting Procedure — Medication Wasting Procedure §3 Discard the Waste  (PROCEDURE, Nursing)
Discard the unused portion into the pharmaceutical waste container. Never discard
controlled substances into a sharps container or a sink.

[O4] Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module — Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module §2 Learning Objective — Documentation  (EDUCATION, Nursing Education)
The learner will demonstrate documenting waste in the automated dispensing cabinet,
including amount wasted, reason, and witness identity.

[O5] Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module — Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module §4 Learning Objective — Diversion Awareness  (EDUCATION, Nursing Education)
The learner will identify behavioural and documentation indicators that may suggest
drug diversion, and will state the non-punitive reporting pathway.

[O6] Medication Wasting Procedure — Medication Wasting Procedure §5 Resolve Discrepancies  (PROCEDURE, Nursing)
If the cabinet reports a discrepancy, notify the charge nurse and pharmacy. Complete
the discrepancy resolution form before leaving the unit.

For each item above, reply with one line:
<id>: <CONFLICTS|PARTIAL|ALIGNED|UNRELATED> | <HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW> | one-sentence reason

Then one final line:
GAP: what this requirement demands that none of the items above provides, or NONE
